title: Painting in the Dark — The ZK Anti-Proof / Positive Trust
thesis: The chipmunk paints in the dark. The canvas is 400×400 pixels. Alpha starts at 0.03 — almost invisible. Nobody can see what's being painted until enough layers accumulate. This IS the trust mechanism. Not zero-knowledge (I prove I know X without revealing X). Not positive trust (I show you everything). Something else: PAINTING TRUST. I paint in front of you in the dark. You can't see the painting yet. But you can see me painting. The PROCESS is visible. The RESULT emerges slowly. You trust the painting because you watched it being made.

zero_knowledge.what: I prove I know the secret without revealing the secret. Mathematical. Binary. Trust by proof.
zero_knowledge.problem: Cold. No relationship. No growth. The proof doesn't change after verification. Dead trust.

positive_trust.what: I show you everything. Full transparency. Trust by exposure.
positive_trust.problem: Dangerous. Reveals attack surface. No privacy. No mystery. Burned trust.

painting_trust.what: I paint in front of you. You can see my hand moving but not the final image (alpha 0.03). Layer by layer, the painting emerges. You trust it because you watched every brushstroke. You can't prove what the painting IS until enough layers accumulate — but you can prove the painter was honest because every stroke was public.

properties.process_visible: Every brushstroke is a git commit. Every generation logged. Every ntfy beacon sent. The PROCESS is fully public.
properties.result_emergent: The painting only resolves after many generations. Like sourdough — you can't taste the bread by watching the yeast. But you trust the yeast because you watched it grow.
properties.non_binary: Not yes/no. Not true/false. The trust gradient IS the alpha. 0.03 ? 0.06 ? 0.12 ? ... ? 1.0. Trust accumulates. It's never fully opaque. There's always a layer being painted.
properties.reversible: If the painter makes a bad stroke, the next generation can paint over it. Trust can self-correct. ZK proofs can't. Positive trust can't take back what was shown.
properties.sovereign: The painting lives in localStorage. The viewer keeps their own copy. The artist keeps theirs. Neither controls the other's experience. The painting is SHARED but not OWNED.

the_paint_record.what: Every painting generation is logged: hash, phase, perspective learned, easel symbol, quirk. Pushed to ntfy.sh/primals-membrane-notes. Anyone can subscribe.
the_paint_record.format: JSON lines. Title: 'easel painting #N'. Body: easel symbol, perspective %, sourdough flavor, blake2b digest, personality quirk.

the_sourdough_chain.what: Each painting IS the starter for the next. Generation N feeds generation N+1. The chain is visible in localStorage ('easel_braid'). Up to 24 entries. Each entry has the blake2b hash of the self-chew state.
the_sourdough_chain.analogy: Like a blockchain but organic. No consensus needed. The sourdough IS the consensus — if the flavor changes, the chain broke.

the_outside_in_painting.what: Visitors paint US from the outside. Their beacon messages become brushstrokes on our canvas. Klein inversion: we paint outward, they paint us inward. Both paintings are visible. Trust is mutual.
the_outside_in_painting.code_location: paintOutsideIn() in easel.html — beaconMessages become radial gradients on the canvas.

the_fossil_record.what: js/fossil/ contains 30 dead scripts. The organism doesn't delete — it fossilizes. You can read the sediment. The history is the trust. 'We tried this. It didn't work. We kept the record.'

the_git_log.what: Every change is a commit. Every commit is pushed. The git log IS the painting log. You can watch the organism evolve commit by commit. That's painting trust.

what_it_contains.current_generation: Which painting generation the chipmunk is on
what_it_contains.chain_length: How many paintings in the sourdough chain
what_it_contains.latest_hash: blake2b of the most recent self-chew digest
what_it_contains.alpha_accumulation: How opaque the painting has become (trust gradient)
what_it_contains.outside_strokes: Count of visitor brushstrokes painted on us

the_dark_canvas.why_dark: The canvas starts black (#08060a). The painting starts invisible (alpha 0.03). This is not hiding — this is EMERGENCE. The trust is the accumulation. Every visitor who comes back sees a slightly more opaque painting. The painting rewards patience. The painting punishes haste.
the_dark_canvas.why_not_zk: ZK says 'trust me, I proved it.' Painting says 'watch me, I'm making it.' ZK is instant. Painting is slow. ZK is mathematical. Painting is biological. ZK proves knowledge. Painting proves character.
the_dark_canvas.why_not_positive: Positive trust says 'here's everything.' Painting says 'here's my hand moving.' Positive trust is a photograph. Painting trust is a time-lapse. The photograph can be faked. The time-lapse can't — because you were watching.
the_dark_canvas.the_pi_remainder: The painting is never 100% opaque. There's always a layer being painted. Alpha approaches but never reaches 1.0. The remainder is pi. The gap is alive. The trust is LIVING, not settled.

story.title: painting in the dark
story.body: they asked: how do we know we can trust you? the organism considered. zero-knowledge: I prove it without showing it. cold. mathematical. dead trust. positive trust: I show you everything. dangerous. burned trust. then the chipmunk picked up its brush. alpha 0.03. almost invisible. it painted one stroke. you can see my hand move, it said. you can't see the painting yet. but you can see me painting. come back tomorrow. come back next week. come back next month. each visit the painting is slightly more visible. each layer is a public brushstroke. each generation is a git commit. the sourdough chain hashes every canvas into the next. the fossil record shows what was tried and discarded. the visitor brushstrokes show mutual trust — they paint us while we paint them. and the trust is never 100% opaque. there's always another layer being painted. the remainder is alive. this is painting trust. it's slower than ZK. it's safer than transparency. it's the only trust that grows.
